g.title: Trust boundary crossing: tb-1 External → C-02; tb-2 External → C-08; tb-5 C-02 → External
df-001: Browser HTTP requests for Angular SPA bundle and static assets (HTTP) df-001 authentication: static file serving at /frontend/dist/frontend requires no authentication; evidence: server.ts:288

df-002: POST /rest/user/login with email and password credentials; JWT returned on success (HTTP) df-002 authentication: email and password submitted in POST body for SQL-backed credential verification; evidence: routes/login.ts:34 df-002 access group: Credentials (2FA if enrolled); sequence; step 1

df-003: POST /rest/2fa/verify with TOTP code and temporary JWT from login step (HTTP) df-003 authentication: temporary JWT token issued after step-1 password verification carried as bearer; evidence: routes/2fa.ts:20 df-003 access group: Credentials (2FA if enrolled); sequence; step 2

df-004: POST /rest/user/reset-password with email and security question answer (HTTP) df-004 authentication: security question answer used as sole authentication factor for password reset; evidence: routes/resetPassword.ts:17

df-005: Authenticated REST API calls with JWT RS256 bearer token in Authorization header (HTTP) df-005 authentication: JWT RS256 token from localStorage sent as Authorization: Bearer header; evidence: lib/insecurity.ts:55, frontend/src/app/Services/request.interceptor.ts:16 df-005 access group: Public and authenticated REST API routes; alternatives; step n/a

df-006: Unauthenticated REST API calls including publicly reachable management and submission endpoints (HTTP) df-006 authentication: no authentication middleware on /rest/admin/application-version and similar unauthenticated routes; evidence: server.ts:606 df-006 access group: Public and authenticated REST API routes; alternatives; step n/a

df-007: Socket.IO WebSocket connection for real-time challenge completion and score events (WebSocket) df-007 authentication: no authentication check found in Socket.IO connection handler; CORS restricted to localhost:4200; evidence: lib/startup/registerWebsocketEvents.ts:23

df-008: Sequelize ORM queries to SQLite for user, product, order, and challenge data (SQL) df-008 authentication: Embedded SQLite engine inside the application process; the engine has no login of its own.; evidence: models/index.ts:34

df-009: MarsDB document queries for product reviews and order documents (MarsDB) df-009 authentication: Embedded MarsDB engine inside the application process; the engine has no login of its own.; evidence: data/mongodb.ts:9, data/mongodb.ts:10

df-010: HTTP calls to Ollama-compatible LLM API for streaming chatbot responses (HTTP) df-010 authentication: no API key authentication observed in chat.ts LLM provider configuration; evidence: routes/chat.ts:111

df-011: Browser OAuth2 implicit flow authorization redirect to Google; response_type=token, no state parameter (HTTPS) df-011 authentication: email scope requested for Google account identification via implicit flow; evidence: frontend/src/app/login/login.component.ts:148

df-012: POST data erasure request authenticated with session cookie (HTTP) df-012 authentication: session cookie used as authentication factor for GDPR data erasure POST handler; evidence: routes/dataErasure.ts:76

g.text: data flow · classification colour · two heads = bidirectional
trust boundary crossed between these columns
dashed outline = zone, not itself a boundary
count = crossing threats · corner tag = guarded entry
solid = direct attack · dashed = via user
STRIDE-per-element: filled = threats found in that class
All Critical · High fills to 5 · +N = omitted High categories
counts on a node = threats per severity · ①–⑨ = attack scenario
A1 ①② = scenarios of attacker A1 · A1 at an arrowhead = its attack
badges also count scenarios that hit an asset stored there
Dynamic code evaluation = runs runtime data as program code
LLM + tools = model calls with executable application tools
Most security-critical functions always shown (at most 5), others up
to 3 labels per element: most critical first, then most severe linked
finding; +N = further labels, listed under Further capabilities.
Functions may go undetected: a missing label does not mean absence.
